name: Foreclosure Data Hub API
description: REST API for U.S. foreclosure and REO property data across all 50 states, updated daily, with filters for geography, sale date, sale status, owner, and estimated value.
notes: Foreclosure Data Hub publishes public API documentation for x-api-key authenticated REST endpoints that return normalized, paginated JSON foreclosure and REO records. API access is paid (included on Pro and Business plans; commercial API plans available), with a limited trial.
